data: {"data":[{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"dagwuttbaeey5hftkhkhz060","label":"Gliding into Danger","content":"The party strapped on their Hang Gliders and prepared to leap from the mountain. With a collective push, they launched into the air, gliding over the vast tundra landscape, where violent winds whipped around them and dust swirled in the misty powder. As they descended, the view of snow-covered peaks and forested valleys unfolded beneath them, until they finally touched down in a Farmer's Field Beside Byriver. Smoke billowed into the sky, and the unmistakable roar of a dragon echoed beyond the city gates. \"It's hang right in time!\" one of them shouted just before the jump.","image":null,"index":51,"categories":["Conflict","Suspense"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"dr5ov3asccz4hs7u8nq6fjfz","label":"Frosty Assault on Haldraxis","content":"E.t. Skittles's follow-up attack missed its mark. Bronn Boromir seized the opportunity, conjuring a hand that floated delicately in the air. He wrapped twine around the hand, securing a bundle of twenty-one Ice-Flower Petals. As he blew gently, the petals burst forth in a frosty spray, striking Haldraxis in the neck. The icy mist crept across the dragon's stony flesh, causing blood to seep through the bandages. Haldraxis reared back, bellowing a threat before disengaging and flying out of the cave.","image":null,"index":48,"categories":["Combat","Victory"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"fxb6oyykyzo5u3j3lohohstz","label":"Gideon Xander's Song and Dookeldorn Bludvart's Strike","content":"As Gideon Xander advanced into the chamber, he began to sing to the sun, his voice echoing against the stone walls. Dookeldorn Bludvart seized the moment, driving a bolt into Haldraxis's wounded throat, reopening his injuries. The force of the attack jolted Haldraxis awake, his eyes wide as he gasped for breath. The dragon's fate hung in the balance, caught between the song of hope and the brutal reality of Dookeldorn's strike.","image":null,"index":58,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"i0f5bwdbol99lx4q4elodvtd","label":"E.t. Skittles' Deathly Magic","content":"Eugene Thomas Skittles unleashed a command, whispering, \"warm sunshine,\" which lulled one of the Mountain Giants into a deep slumber. The giant, already teetering on the brink of exhaustion, succumbed to the soothing words, his eyes growing heavy before he slumped to the ground, unconscious. Meanwhile, another giant, still standing, felt the effects of Skittles' magic but managed to resist, remaining alert despite the overwhelming fatigue. The remaining giant faced Bronn Boromir, who swung his great club with determination, landing a solid blow that echoed through the battlefield. The clash of magic and might left the Mountain Giants reeling, one incapacitated and the other struggling to maintain its composure.","image":null,"index":57,"categories":["Combat","Victory"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"k81ms7p55j22gw6d1nrk1i4m","label":"Haldraxis's Wounded Slumber","content":"As the party entered the chamber of Haldraxis, they found the wounded dragon asleep, bandaged and resting beside a cold, Dragon-Sized Bowl Of Chamomile Tea. The Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold) before them was surprisingly small, a stark contrast to the vast treasures typically associated with dragons. Behind Haldraxis, a massive opening in the mountainside revealed how he had entered the cave, suggesting a grander entrance than the secret passage they had previously discovered. The dragon bore wounds from crossbow bolts, highlighting his vulnerability amidst the grandeur of his lair. The party observed the scene before them, a mix of concern and curiosity in the air.","image":null,"index":45,"categories":["Intrigue","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"kwvkfmxg6vuygl84xbi1mi59","label":"Haldraxis' Fiery Threat","content":"Haldraxis roared awake, his voice echoing through the cave as he demanded to know who had disturbed his slumber. He declared that the city would burn before he met his end, his anger palpable as he disengaged from the confrontation. In a swift motion, he flew out through the Mountainside Opening, soaring toward Byriver with the intent to raise it to the ground. As he departed, he bellowed, \"Here not before your precious city burns!\"","image":null,"index":49,"categories":["Conflict","Betrayal"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"m3ckmj6pn6pwub16srn3pde1","label":"Bronn Boromir's Vow of Vengeance Against Haldraxis","content":"As the group debated their next move, Gideon Xander suggested waking Haldraxis to talk. Bronn Boromir intervened, reminding everyone of the dragon's brutal past. \"He murdered my brother,\" Bronn declared. \"At the end of the day, he must die.\" E.t. Skittles supported Bronn's plan, reinforcing the sentiment that Haldraxis deserved no mercy. The party rallied around the idea of vengeance, united in their resolve to confront the dragon.","image":null,"index":46,"categories":["Conflict","Revenge"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"mcacpl77bzcyc4s9c4uy7ysi","label":"Gideon Xander's Weakened Curse on the Mountain Giants","content":"Gideon Xander Zander raised his hand, calling down a weakening curse upon the Mountain Giants. As he spoke, the air shimmered with magic, and two of the towering figures staggered under the weight of his spell, their resolve visibly faltering. One giant managed to resist the effects, standing firm despite Gideon's incantation. The remaining Mountain Giants, already demoralized from previous attacks, felt the curse seep into their bones, leaving them vulnerable and shaken. Gideon raised his hands in prayer, thanking Nissan for the strength bestowed upon him.","image":null,"index":56,"categories":["Conflict","Heroism"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"nhbb1g9hlhzl5ndq5cb80xph","label":"Giant's Struggle to Lift the City Gate","content":"The giant, with a bronze bolt lodged in his side, strained as he lifted the heavy City Gate. His muscles were taut as he pushed the Gate upward, managing to raise it to about a third of its height. Observers noted the effort, commenting on the giant's strength despite his injury and the sheer physicality of the moment. The giant's struggle showcased his resilience in the face of pain.","image":null,"index":55,"categories":["Heroism","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"nioemmss7bkzsyyd81lcikmy","label":"Mountain Giants at the City Gate","content":"As the party approached the City Gate of Bir River, three Mountain Giants loomed, their massive forms casting shadows over the ground. One giant, straining to lift the heavy Gate, suddenly turned and spotted the group, nodding to the others in acknowledgment. This signal transformed the Mountain Giants' demeanor as they shifted their attention to the party, recognizing them as a potential threat. The Mountain Giants prepared to confront the newcomers, prompting the party to brace for an imminent clash. The roar of a dragon echoed in the distance.","image":null,"index":52,"categories":["Conflict","Suspense"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"rkvztfpr6se8dvso6yxcgy5h","label":"Dookeldorn Bludvart's Heartbreak and Summoning","content":"As the battle raged on, Dookeldorn Bludvart's gaze fell upon a Scorched Teaspoon resting in Haldraxis's dragon-sized tea bowl. He called forth a small dragon companion named Pepe, who eagerly emerged, ready to assist in the fight. Pepe began rummaging through the remnants of the battlefield, driven by an instinct that resonated with Dookeldorn.","image":null,"index":59,"categories":["Loss","Heroism","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"smaivw2dyi7vv1of1tntwt4h","label":"Bronn Boromir's Fury Against the Mountain Giants","content":"As the mountain giant outside the City Gate strained to lift it, another giant charged at Bronn Boromir, swinging a massive greatclub that knocked him down. Bronn rose from the ground and declared, \"The forge of battle I intemperate,\" tapping into a newfound rage. He wielded a greatclub taken from a fallen foe, unleashing a fiery attack that struck the giant who had just assaulted him. Flames leapt from his weapon, dealing damage and causing the giant to stagger, saliva dripping from its mouth as it struggled to regain focus. Meanwhile, the other giant continued its effort to force the Gate upward, oblivious to the chaos within.","image":null,"index":54,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"ulpn1fexxr91foj4zlxv0mcn","label":"Sun-Blessed Ambush Planning","content":"Gideon Xander gathered his companions, placing his hands on their foreheads in a brief sun-blessing, infusing them with guidance for the battle ahead. As they strategized, Bronn Boromir proposed using eight Ice-Flower Petals affixed to a crossbow bolt to strike the dragon, while Dookeldorn Bludvart prepared to fire into its throat. Gideon decided to bolster Bronn's efforts instead of risking a curse on the sleeping beast, ensuring their plan was coordinated and effective. Bronn and Dookeldorn readied their magical attacks, preparing for the confrontation with the dragon.","image":null,"index":47,"categories":["Conflict","Heroism"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"xe2y9ecxn83sf7ifd52gwd9w","label":"Dookeldorn Bludvart's Deadly Shot","content":"As the giant strained to lift the City Gate, Dookeldorn Bludvart took aim and released a crossbow bolt that struck true, piercing the creature's throat. Blood gushed from the wound, and the giant let out a gurgling roar, his windpipe filling with blood as he struggled to remain upright. Despite the grievous injury, he continued to push against the Gate. Dookeldorn said, \"What was that? I'm sorry. I don't speak bitch,\" as the giant's guttural sounds filled the air. The scene was chaotic, with the giant still standing, albeit barely, as he fought against his impending doom.","image":null,"index":53,"categories":["Combat","Heroism"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T23:02:05.484000","updated_at":null,"id":"yg79umnj8tt3yvogc0ns1ogt","label":"Assessing the Dragon's Escape","content":"As the party gathered their wits, they quickly assessed the treasure Hoard (About Five Thousand Gold), which contained five thousand gold pieces. Peering out of the gaping hole from which Halldraxis had fled, they noticed a mountain river flowing nearby, with a narrow ledge that could serve as a potential escape route. They recalled Hang Gliders lying near the bodies of fallen adventurers in the cavern, prompting thoughts of aerial maneuvers. Bronn Boromir remembered the mountain giant's failed attempt to snowboard down the rocky slope, a reminder of the dangers that lay ahead. With time slipping away, they felt the urgency to act.","image":null,"index":50,"categories":["Conflict","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7mrzx00000akpsytd8b0f"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"bmcdfubg0dlknltzhscui8af","label":"E.t. Skittles's Failed Seduction of Haldraxis","content":"As the sun hung high in the sky, E.t. Skittles emerged from his hiding place, attempting to charm the imposing red dragon, Haldraxis. \"Hey now, I was supposed to be the doing the seducing around here,\" he quipped. He then cast a sickening ray towards Haldraxis, but the spell missed its mark entirely. E.t. swiftly retreated, leaving the dragon unimpressed.","image":null,"index":34,"categories":["Hijinx","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"c09tb3hb978iu31mj8es89sq","label":"Searing Troll Fat and Echoing Hammering","content":"As the party positioned themselves in the cave, Dookeldorn Bludvart lobbed the Troll Fat into the path of the steam. The steam rushed over the fat, causing it to sear and bubble, filling the air with an appetizing aroma. After a few moments, the smell wafted through the cave, enticing the party. Meanwhile, a steady hammering echoed from deeper within the cave, hinting at the presence of something—or someone—working away in the shadows.","image":null,"index":39,"categories":["Loot","Exploration","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"cdlx3az14sis64d4b903hcty","label":"Misty Mist-Filled Foyer and Mechanical Bellows","content":"Inside the skull's mouth, the party entered a cave hazy with mist, revealing a Mist-Filled Foyer-like space. In the center stood an automatic accordion machine, its rotating mechanism building up steam every five seconds before bellowing it out through the dragon's mouth. The steam shot forth in a single direction, creating an eerie atmosphere as the adventurers took in their surroundings. Greg noted that the machine was bolted to the ground, while Mike questioned, \"What kind of wizarding wall shit is this?\" The group began to strategize their next moves, intrigued by the mechanical device before them.","image":null,"index":40,"categories":["Exploration","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"chhx038v14axqb76nl99b01o","label":"Gideon Xander's Cleansing Ritual","content":"Before departing the Giant Camp, Gideon Xander gathered the bodies of the trolls and the remnants of their belongings. He set them ablaze, the flames licking at the sky as he prayed to the sun, asking it to cleanse the beasts of their sins and accept them into its warm glow. As the fire crackled, Gideon hoped that the sun would receive these creatures, ensuring they were honored in their passing. Dookeldorn Bludvart and Bronn Boromir reacted with disdain and humor, with Dookeldorn remarking on the 'disgusting' nature of the warm glow. Gideon remained focused on his ritual, paying homage to his deity as the smoke rose into the air.","image":null,"index":30,"categories":["Ritual","Heroism"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"cw6mbvpo8957xloguntptdea","label":"Journey to the Old Temple Ruins","content":"The party set out for the Old Temple Ruins, where the remnants of an old temple stood against the elements, its foundation intact but its walls and ceiling mostly collapsed. As they approached, Bronn Boromir urged, \"We must prepare quickly,\" while Dookeldorn Bludvart inquired about the absence of threats, confirming there were no Mountain Giants, only some bunnies nearby. They followed the map provided by Philip, navigating the mountain pass. Upon reaching the clearing, Bronn remarked, \"Looks a fine place to fight a dragon,\" to which E.t. Skittles countered, \"The fine place to get eaten by a dragon.\" With the ruins before them, the party braced for the imminent arrival of Haldraxis, who had extorted gold from By River under the threat of burning the town.","image":null,"index":31,"categories":["Conflict","Exploration"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"exteh6ue0d1v6k2t90u8kqda","label":"Cave of the Dragon Skull","content":"As the party ascended the mountainside, they reached a cave carved into the rock, resembling a massive dragon skull. The gaping maw of the skull exhaled blasts of hot steam every few seconds, the heat intense enough to singe nearby foliage. \"Praise the sun, a sauna!\" Gideon Xander exclaimed. E.t. Skittles noted the ominous nature of the cave, questioning if it was a trap or merely an obstacle. Recognizing this as the dragon's lair, the adventurers prepared for what lay ahead as they stood before the entrance.","image":null,"index":38,"categories":["Exploration","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"fk8tnebdpzewmoagbf9fumhl","label":"E.t. Skittles Inspects the Dragon-Head Medallion","content":"As E.t. Skittles examined the Dragon-Head Medallion, he noticed that its edges were intricately shaped, suggesting they were designed to fit into a larger mechanism. The group had been investigating the area, with Dookeldorn Bludvart questioning if there was more to explore. E.t. had previously mentioned the significance of the dragon, leading to a discussion about the arrangement of various tablets they had found. E.t. declared, \"I think I know how to solve this puzzle,\" indicating his understanding of the connection between the medallion and the mysterious door they were trying to unlock. The party prepared to piece together the clues before them.","image":null,"index":45,"categories":["Discovery","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"i1d0morliza09ij09atszikq","label":"Gideon Xander's Negotiation with Haldraxis","content":"As Gideon Xander approached the imposing dragon Haldraxis, he declared, \"I have no gold for you. But what I do have is a kindier? We should talk.\" Haldraxis narrowed his sharp orange eyes and retorted, \"You've kept me waiting for this is the third day. I hope you've brought my gold.\" Gideon pressed on, questioning the dragon's motives and suggesting, \"Let's talk about other ways you can get gold. This doesn't seem you. Seems something's wrong here.\" The tension hung in the air as Gideon attempted to steer the conversation away from gold and towards understanding Haldraxis's true desires.","image":null,"index":35,"categories":["Negotiation","Intrigue"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"juebjiceccpny6gu8pzgdqx4","label":"E.t. Skittles Strikes the Mountain Giants","content":"E.t. Skittles swung his greatclub, delivering a powerful blow to the Mountain Giants, who staggered under the impact. The giant, already bleeding from various wounds, felt the weight of the strike and looked defeated. As E.t. turned to face Gideon Xander, the giant's expression reflected a mix of rage and despair, having been thwarted in his attempts to ensnare the adventurers with a trap he had worked on. The giant's resolve began to crumble under the relentless pressure of the heroes' onslaught.","image":null,"index":42,"categories":["Combat","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"n27y4ji4zqycp8feg0ehavq1","label":"Stealthy Doorway Revelation","content":"Bronn Boromir stealthily cracked open the northwest door, supported by Gideon Xander, revealing a cluttered Workshop. Inside, a Mountain Giants was working on a metal contraption, focused entirely on the task at hand and oblivious to the intruders. The room was filled with tables and workbenches, all covered in various designs and half-finished projects, while steam escaped through a hole in the ceiling. As Bronn peered in, he noticed the giant's high-strung demeanor, likely due to the sounds of creatures outside the cave. Gideon cast a spell to create a shower of sparks on the workbench, aiming to distract the giant further.","image":null,"index":41,"categories":["Intrigue","Discovery"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"q6o5mydlmgbxkz0x3inemaug","label":"Haldraxis Takes Flight Amidst Chaos","content":"As Haldraxis prepared to take off, E.t. Skittles clawed at the dragon's hindquarters, attempting to hinder its escape. Bronn Boromir swung his greatclub, striking Haldraxis with a powerful blow. Dookeldorn Bludvart shot at the dragon again, shouting, \"Don't forget your gold!\" The dragon, realizing it was being bested by the adventurers, fanned out its leathery wings and launched into the air, prompting opportunity attacks from the party. The air crackled with tension as the adventurers fought to keep the dragon grounded, their strikes echoing in the desert sky.","image":null,"index":37,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"qdo995jgfx9cjulr6qh0yizc","label":"Bronn Boromir's Telekinetic Takedown of the Giant","content":"As Bronn Boromir emerged from the fog, he spotted the giant preparing to leap from the cave with a rustic rock snowboard. He shouted, \"Nice try, asshole!\" and unleashed his telekinetic ability, aiming to shove the giant off balance. The giant, caught off guard, stumbled as Bronn's psychic force hit him, sending him tumbling down the mountain. The giant's surprised expression was evident as he lost his footing, unable to mount the snowboard correctly. Bronn stood at the cave's edge, watching the giant's chaotic descent.","image":null,"index":44,"categories":["Conflict","Victory"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"txjcq3g1kazsb56oysx47nlt","label":"Gideon Xander's Green Dragon Cleanup","content":"Gideon Xander approached the altar and spotted fresh green dragon dung nearby. With a shovel from his camping gear, he began scooping it up, muttering, \"Naughty dragon. Leave only take only pictures. Leave only footprints.\" E.t. Skittles, seeing the opportunity, insisted, \"You can't take all this good stuff on your own. They call this black gold in the hell!\" As Gideon helped E.t. fill his shell with the dung, E.t. remarked, \"That's even better because it just matches my shell,\" while pretending to stuff the dung into imaginary pockets. Gideon joked about the delusion of pockets, making the cleanup a bizarre endeavor.","image":null,"index":32,"categories":["Hijinx","Banter"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"uw87doihyudctrb4esl1vthl","label":"Gideon Xander's Healing Touch","content":"As the giant swung his greatclub, E.t. Skittles felt the impact of the blow, exclaiming, \"It hurts. I don't it.\" The giant, visibly defeated, turned to face Gideon Xander, who rushed forward. Gideon took E.t.'s head in his hands and implored, \"My son, the light is calling. Lay down your weapon.\" The giant complied, putting down his club, allowing Gideon to heal E.t. and bring him back to his feet, ready to continue the confrontation.","image":null,"index":43,"categories":["Heroism","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"wk18j8dyu8yipotyi0060p3h","label":"Gideon Xander's Prayer and E.t. Skittles's Disguise","content":"Gideon Xander stood near the altar, arms raised in prayer, thanking the heavenly orb for cleansing his bowels. He sang hymns to the sun, fully exposed and unaware of the impending arrival of the dragon. Meanwhile, E.t. Skittles hid at a distance, preparing to don an improvised disguise as a female dragon, intending to woo the creature. He expressed his intention to remain hidden, acknowledging that while Gideon was bold, he preferred to stay out of sight, away from the altar and the traps set for the dragon.","image":null,"index":33,"categories":["Hijinx","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"wlprz6c42012yqwehvs05sn3","label":"The Dragon-Head Medallion Unlocks the Door","content":"After much deliberation, the party arranged the three circular tablets into the correct order, with the Dragon-Head Medallion placed prominently at the top. Dookeldorn Bludvart flipped the two remaining tablets, while Bronn Boromir and E.t. Skittles provided suggestions about the arrangement. Gideon Xander declared the order, asserting that the head should be at the top and the tail at the bottom. As they completed the arrangement, the stone door began to rumble ominously, signaling that their efforts had succeeded. With a final push, the door creaked open, revealing what lay beyond.","image":null,"index":46,"categories":["Discovery","Conflict"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:54:12.957000","updated_at":null,"id":"xgrx6kbguex7ak27975lc9xq","label":"Haldraxis' Vengeful Claw","content":"Haldraxis lunged forward, his claws glinting in the light as he swiped at Dookeldorn Bludvart, landing a powerful blow that sent him sprawling to the ground. \"The humans will pay!\" the young red dragon roared, his voice echoing with fury. The attack left Dookeldorn prone as Haldraxis prepared for his next move.","image":null,"index":36,"categories":["Conflict","Combat"],"campaign_id":"cmr9ilyjy00020ahu90yhvzx6","session_id":"cmrb7m8a300000aj6fe0v0ucr"},{"created_at":"2026-07-07T22:23:05.505000","updated_at":null,"id":"dip6lbn22j873hryspwfxfri","label":"E.t. Skittles's Dragon Disguise Attempt","content":"As the party deliberated their route to Old Temple Ruins, E.t. Skittles smeared mud across his turtle body and searched for red berries to crush and dye his skin, attempting to create a dragon disguise. He etched patterns into the mud to mimic scales. His efforts achieved a level of effectiveness that surprised his companions, who remarked on the quality of his artistic endeavor.
